移除测试留下的课程、资料、题目、学习记录、掌握度、笔记和计划。清理后保留账户与基: Clear courses, materials, questions, answer history, mastery, notes and plans from the current learning space. Your account is kept.
确认清理全部学习数据: Confirm to clear all learning data
将清理此设备未登录学习空间的全部个人数据。: All personal data in this device's signed-out learning space will be deleted.
将清理当前学习账户的本地及云端数据，同时清理此设备未登录学习空间的数据。其他学习: The local and cloud data of the current learning account will be cleared, as well as the data of this device that is not logged into the learning space. Other learning accounts are not affected.
此操作无法撤销；已保存的 SAT／ACT 试卷也会移除。: This action cannot be undone; saved SAT/ACT exams will also be removed.
先导出当前空间备份: First export the current space backup
无法保存外观，请检查浏览器存储权限: Unable to save appearance, please check browser storage permissions
已登录，将本地学习记录加入你的云端账户: Already logged in, add local learning records to your cloud account
本机保留此账户的离线学习记录。: This machine retains the offline learning records of this account.
比重越高，计划越重视这门学科。0 表示暂不安排。: The higher the proportion, the more emphasis the plan places on this subject. 0 means not scheduled yet.
少量回顾，确认长期保持。: A small review to confirm long-term retention.
只在考前、成绩更新等关键时刻复核。: Only review at critical moments such as before exams and when scores are updated.
还没有可用题目，请先在资料库导入并核验。: There are no available questions yet, please import and verify them in the library first.
立即生效，刷新后保留。学习中的沉浸模式仍可单独切换。: Effective immediately and retained after refresh. Immersion mode during learning can still be switched individually.
阅读与显示：练习页可切换沉浸模式、打开草稿纸。: Reading and display: The practice page can switch immersion mode and open scratch paper.
登录学习账户后，可配对设备并同步学习记录。: After logging in to your learning account, you can pair your device and synchronize your learning records.
保存题目、笔记、计划和作答记录: Save questions, notes, plans and answer records
先检查文件，再合并记录: Check files first, then merge records
保留现有记录，不重复计算已存在的作答。: Keep existing records and do not double-count existing responses.
个人内容先保存在本设备。登录后仅同步到自己的账户；公开分享需要单独确认。: Personal content is saved on this device first. After logging in, it will only be synced to your own account; public sharing requires separate confirmation.
当前设备的私有配置已解锁，AI 与账户可使用同一份配置连接。: The current device's private configuration has been unlocked, and the AI and account can be connected using the same configuration.
输入网站配置口令，解锁 GitHub Pages 的私有云连接。口令不是 Sup: Enter your website configuration password to unlock GitHub Pages' private cloud connection. The password is not a Supabase token, nor is it an account password.
配置可用，需检查连接: Configuration available, need to check connection
连接检查不会生成题目；技术诊断只在这里显示。: Connection checks do not generate questions; technical diagnostics are only shown here.
登录学习账户: Log in to your learning account
登录账户以备份学习记录并同步至其他设备。: Log in to your account to back up your learning records and sync them to other devices.
已有账户，去登录: Already have an account? Log in
还没有账户，创建一个: Don’t have an account yet? Create one
注册可能需要邮件确认。密码与会话通过加密连接发送。: Registration may require email confirmation. Passwords and sessions are sent over an encrypted connection.
